name: Broadcast Lens
description: The optics and head of a broadcast camera: the picture rebuilt from a set broadcast resolution, a soft lens with colour fringes towards the edges, the edge enhancer, sensor noise and a vignette.

params.label: Broadcast resolution
params.doc: The number of lines the picture is reduced to before it is rebuilt at screen size; native leaves the picture at screen size.

params.label: Rebuild filter
params.doc: How the reduced picture is rebuilt at screen size: smooth blends neighbouring lines, sharp keeps edges crisper with a slight overshoot.

params.label: Softness
params.doc: The optical blur radius in broadcast pixels; 0 adds no blur.

params.label: Chromatic aberration
params.doc: How far red and blue part at the corners, as a share of the picture width; the fringe grows from none at the centre towards the edges.

params.label: Detail
params.doc: How strongly the edge enhancer boosts mid-frequency edges; 0 is off.

params.label: Detail limit
params.doc: The most the edge enhancer may change a pixel, in display colour; keeps the halos small.

params.label: Sensor noise
params.doc: How much noise the sensor adds, more in the shadows than in the highlights; 0 is none.

params.label: Noise size
params.doc: The size of a noise speck in broadcast pixels.

params.label: Vignette
params.doc: How far the lens darkens the corners; 0 is none.
